mapper.sql: select e.elevator_id, e.elevator_code, e.brand, e.model, e.building_id, e.unit_no, e.maintain_unit, e.install_date, e.service_years, e.cert_file_id, e.status, e.del_flag, e.create_by, e.create_time, e.update_by, e.update_time, e.remark, b.community_id as community_id, c.community_name as community_name, b.building_no as building_no, f.file_name as cert_file_name from elevator e left join building b on e.building_id = b.building_id left join community c on b.community_id = c.community_id left join sys_file f on e.cert_file_id = f.file_id and f.del_flag = '0'
mapper.select: select count(1) from elevator where del_flag = '0'

select c.community_id as communityId, c.community_name as communityName, count(e.elevator_id) as elevatorCount from community c left join building b on b.community_id = c.community_id and b.del_flag = '0' left join elevator e on e.building_id = b.building_id and e.del_flag = '0' where c.del_flag = '0' group by c.community_id, c.community_name order by c.community_id
mapper.update: update elevator set status = #{status}, update_time = sysdate() where elevator_id = #{elevatorId}
